title: Q-SAYDO-rules-STANDARDS-FIRST-1: says STANDARDS-FIRST-1, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:STANDARDS-FIRST-1
**Status:** open

The system states `STANDARDS-FIRST-1` (rules) and its code does not do it: python3 -m foundation standards --check: seed/worker/src/index.js serves /api/plans, which is not registered in seed/standards/surfaces.json (new surface without discovery)

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:STANDARDS-FIRST-1` exits 0.
